owners.eventOwner: Visible Journey card spatial entry/return and committed manual flip boundaries.
owners.transport: Shared decoded gameplay SFX engine with bounded HTMLAudio fallback.
owners.voicePolicy: Three stable entry-layer IDs plus one independent manual-flip ID; replacement stops prior voices.
owners.preloadPolicy: Prepare only when Sounds are enabled and the Journey card presentation is eligible.
owners.settingsPolicy: Every preload/start checks gameSoundsEnabled; global Sounds OFF invokes the full stop.
owners.interruptionPolicy: Presentation cleanup, replacement, route cleanup and global Settings cleanup stop decoded and fallback voices.
owners.physicalAcceptance: NEEDS PHYSICAL TEST for speaker balance, timing, route continuity and sustained thermal behavior.

owners.eventOwner: Shared sweetPopIn visible mesh/bounce entry for fresh, retry and Continue boards.
owners.transport: Shared decoded gameplay SFX engine; no additional media/context or fallback.
owners.voicePolicy: Three stable voices for one entrance: setting up boards at.5 base gain, plump and setting up2 at.7. Replacement invalidates prior active/pending layers and scoped stop token.
owners.preloadPolicy: Warm only the three supplied layers during fresh/load entry preparation when Sounds are enabled. Never await audio to reveal the board.
owners.settingsPolicy: Preload/start require gameSoundsEnabled; global registry full-stop cancels pending/active voice. ON never replays.
owners.interruptionPolicy: Normal animation completion, abort, watchdog, replacement and global stop retire the voice; engine owns hidden/pagehide and isolation. Audio-clock cutoff and 50ms fade bound playback to entry duration.
owners.physicalAcceptance: NEEDS PHYSICAL TEST for onset, fade and speaker balance on iPhone.

owners.eventOwner: New Reward hero enter, initial crumble sprite playback and unlocked-card transition; accepted taps reuse CTA owner. Accepted reveal/collect taps layer klik plop with CTA at the same synchronous contact, including queued collect deduplication.
owners.transport: Shared decoded SFX engine; no new media/context/timers.
owners.voicePolicy: Four stable once-per-presentation voices. Happy starts at screen-entry timeline0 at.5 base gain and continues through reveal; intro/crumble at.7 and pufreveal at1. Standard SFX master applies. Cleanup/collect retires all four. One additional bounded tap voice at base gain1, retriggered only by accepted input; presentation finish preserves it through exit, screen cleanup stops it.
owners.preloadPolicy: Only this five-source package before reward image preparation, gated by Sounds setting; no visual wait.
owners.settingsPolicy: Preload/start require gameSoundsEnabled. Full-stop registry cancels pending/active voices. Unmute cannot replay past contacts, but a new reveal contact in the current visible session is allowed. Screen cleanup/replacement invalidates the session.
owners.interruptionPolicy: Replacement, cleanup and collect retire all reward voices. Reveal stops interim voices before puf. Shared engine owns hidden/pagehide/isolation. The tap tail survives presentation finish only; screen cleanup/replacement/full stop cancel it.
owners.physicalAcceptance: NEEDS PHYSICAL TEST for reveal sync, CTA balance and audible tails.
